lyrics:
[intro]
[verse]
Gravity pulling me back to your door
I've been here a thousand times before
Your silhouette dancing in the pale moonlight
A ghost of a feeling that's holding me tight
[chorus]
I'm spinning in circles, caught in your tide
Nowhere to run and nowhere to hide
Round and around, the cycle won't break
Drowning in every move that you make
[verse]
The friction is burning, a slow steady heat
It's pulsing through pavement right under my feet
Your touch is a magnet, a pull in the dark
You're leaving a bruise, you're leaving a spark
[chorus]
I'm spinning in circles, caught in your tide
Nowhere to run and nowhere to hide
Round and around, the cycle won't break
Drowning in every move that you make
[bridge]
It’s an endless orbit, a loop in my head
Words left unsaid, in the space of the bed
I’m losing my footing, I’m losing my way
But I need the night just to face the new day
[chorus]
I'm spinning in circles, caught in your tide
Nowhere to run and nowhere to hide
Round and around, the cycle won't break
Drowning in every move that you make
[outro]
